correctness.rationale: The spherical harmonics addition formula identifies E_l E_l*=(l+1)G_l where G_l(x,y)=U_l(<x,y>) for normalized surface probability measure. Opposite roots imply a 12-dimensional parity compatible quotient, with reduced M_l=2U_l(<r_i,r_j>). The 12 root lines split into three mutually orthogonal 4-sets, giving the orthogonality graph 3K4 (spectrum 3 mult3 and -1 mult9). The signed off-diagonal matrix S=2WW^T-2I for W^TW=3I has eigenvalues 4 mult4 and -2 mult8; even-degree A=J-I-B has eigenvalues 8 mult1,-4 mult2,0 mult9. Chebyshev values w=U_l(1/2), c=U_l(0) yield exact even and odd eigenvalue tables, and their periods 6 and 4 imply M_{l+12}=M_l+24I. Exact small-degree rank defects and strict eigenvalue lower bounds at all higher degrees prove the permanent rank12 from l=11. Independently re-created all 12 root lines and matrices and checked eigenvalue/rank formulas through degree40, with exact polynomial/U_l recurrences.
residual_risks: Finite exact checks through l=40 are corroboration; infinite full-rank theorem uses periodic Chebyshev formulas plus linear growth lower bounds.
Eigenvalue magnitudes depend on the stated normalized surface-measure convention.
